en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall, rectangular brick tower with crenellations at the top standing in an open square, with a few pedestrians in late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century clothing. Mountains rise in the background and multi‑story buildings border the square. The printed caption beneath the image reads "Torre Vanga." The word "Trento." is printed in red at the upper right, followed by extensive handwritten correspondence in French covering the right half and bottom of the card. Along the left edge is a vertical printer's credit: "Stengel & Co., Dresden-Berlin. 7173."
